source: Icy Veins / Wowhead TBC guides + WCL top Combat parses
summary: Sinister Strike to build combo points, keep Slice and Dice rolling at all times, maintain Rupture, Eviscerate as the dump finisher. Blade Flurry and Adrenaline Rush on cooldown.

Backstab.note: dagger+behind combo builder  -  Combat builds use Sinister Strike, not Backstab; heavy Backstab means wrong spec or action bar

Mutilate.note: Assassination combo builder  -  wrong spec entirely for a Combat build

Hemorrhage.note: Subtlety combo builder  -  wrong spec for Combat

breakpoint.note: Slice and Dice uptime is the single most important metric for Combat  -  it should be up nearly 100% of the fight after the opener. Sinister Strike should be the dominant spell after auto attacks. Rupture adds sustained bleed damage and should maintain high uptime.

advisory: Combat (Swords/Maces) is the dominant TBC raid rogue spec. Slice and Dice must never drop  -  refreshing it at 1 stack is fine. Adrenaline Rush doubles energy regeneration for 15s and should be used on cooldown. Blade Flurry adds a second swing for 15s  -  excellent on multi-target. Expose Armor (if assigned by raid leader) replaces one Eviscerate every 30s.
